reason: Imports Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness as continuable context through agent tools and a Web GUI action, with optional creation of a new session.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 历史会话解析并导入 DeepSeek Harness，作为可继续使用的上下文。
summaries.en: Imports Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness as context that can be continued in a new session.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code session JSONL files from ~/.claude/projects
Lists available Claude Code sessions and metadata
Parses and imports session content as seed context or Markdown
Creates and opens a new DeepSeek Harness session when requested
Provides a Web GUI import action
